subject: Committed spend drawdown options for Stello Health - deferred credit acceleration
messages:
From: Jamie Park <jamie.park@stellohealth.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 15 Dec 2026 17:12:00 -0800
Subject: Committed spend structure options for multi-year engagement

Aditya —

Thanks for taking this. We want to lock a committed-usage program for Stello that balances price and cashflow. High level: 3-year relationship, expected net tokens (generation+embedding) of ~18B tokens in Year 1 with a 15% projected growth year-over-year. Procurement prefers an initial prepay wallet (to avoid monthly invoices) with monthly drawdown but with an ability to accelerate credit recognition if our usage exceeds forecast (we'll call this \"acceleration\" / \"deferred credit acceleration\").

Key asks:
- Provide 2–3 commercial structures (front-loaded prepay, levelized multi-year prepay, and a blended committed + overage rate) with example amortization schedules.
- Show how discounts change with ramp / usage bands and what triggers a true-up.
- Confirm billing cadence options (split invoicing, PO acceptance, net30).
- Any accounting or revenue recognition consequences we should be aware of (for our FP&A).

Could you send an illustrative amort table and one-page commercial summary? We'd like to get internal approval and a PO before year-end if possible.

Thanks,
Jamie
Jamie Park
Director, Cloud Platform
Stello Health
procurement@stellohealth.com

From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
To: Jamie Park <jamie.park@stellohealth.com>
Cc: camila_reyes@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 16 Dec 2026 09:08:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Committed spend structure options for multi-year engagement

Jamie —

Appreciate the clarity. Drafted three options below plus an illustrative amortization CSV attached. Short summary: all options use a prepay wallet with monthly drawdown; they differ in how the upfront payments are split and discount applied.

Option 1 — Front-loaded prepay (higher discount):
- Year 1: 60% prepay, Year 2: 25% prepay, Year 3: 15% prepay (wallet funds draw down monthly).
- Effective discount: Year 1 = 28% off list, blended 3-year = ~22%.
- Accelerated credit clause: if monthly usage > 140% of forecast for two consecutive months, we can accelerate remaining wallet credit recognition and apply an overage true-up at 60% of list price (instead of full overage).

Option 2 — Levelized multi-year (stable cashflow):
- Equal prepay each year (33%/33%/34%), smaller year-1 discount (20%) but predictable burn.
- Acceleration trigger at 160% for a single month (less aggressive to avoid cliffs).

Option 3 — Committed baseline + overage band (conservative):
- Prepay covers baseline committed tokens (e.g., 80% of forecast) at deeper discount; overage billed monthly at a pre-agreed overage rate with quarterly true-ups.

Attachments: example_amort_table.csv (simple monthly drawdown example for each option).

Notes / next steps:
- For accounting: front-loaded prepay looks better on cash/CapEx side for you but will require us to schedule revenue deferral on our books (we will provide the revenue-rec template).
- If you prefer split invoices (e.g., 25% upfront + 75% monthly), we can do that as a custom billing schedule.

I've looped in Camila (commercial ops) to prepare a one-page term summary if you want to proceed. If you can share a month-by-month usage expectation for Y1 we can produce the exact amort amounts.

Best,
Aditya Rao
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
[attachment: example_amort_table.csv (text/csv)]

From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 20 Dec 2026 11:02:00 -0800
Subject: Internal: Stello Health — recommended commercial structure (RDW-2027-0421)

Team —

Following Jamie's ask and my initial options, recommend we present Option 1 (front-loaded) with modified acceleration thresholds: trigger at >135% for two consecutive months, overage cap at 75% list for the duration of accelerated recognition. Rationale: Stello has strong usage growth and payroll timing suggests they can pay a larger initial prepay in Q1; front-loaded gives them better unit economics and gives Redwood committed cash.

Suggested commercial terms (to include in term-sheet):
- Total contract value (3yr): illustrative $3.4M (subject to exact token mapping).
- Billing: 40% invoiced at signature (to accommodate Stello PO cycles), 40% invoiced at start of Year 2, remaining 20% amortized monthly across years. Alternatively, accept their request to split: 25% upfront + 75% monthly chargeable to the wallet.
- Acceleration: >135% month-over-month for 2 months triggers acceleration; acceleration only consumes wallet credits (no retroactive cash charge) and sets interim overage rate at 75% list to protect revenue.
- True-up: quarterly reconciliation with credit/ invoice adjustments.

Operational items: Camila, can your team confirm wallet provisioning lead time and how quickly Ops can enable monthly drawdown and reporting? Laura / RevOps, is there any callout we need for revenue deferral language?

Thanks — initial legal review and a v3 term-sheet to Jamie should be fine.

-Aditya

From: Jamie Park <jamie.park@stellohealth.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.ai>
Cc: Stello Health Procurement <procurement@stellohealth.com>
Date: Wed, 05 Jan 2027 09:46:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Committed spend structure options for multi-year engagement

Aditya / Camila —

Thanks — we reviewed internally. We like Option 1 as the starting point but propose two changes:
1) Acceleration trigger lowered to 130% for two consecutive months. We need the ability to burn faster if our pilots scale earlier than expected.
2) Add a 3% annual escalation to the per-token baseline to account for CPI / model cost inflation.

Billing ask: we will issue a PO for 30% at signature (PO attached) and request the remaining 70% be available in the wallet and drawn monthly. Please see attached PO. We expect Net30 payment.

Please update the term sheet and send the final for signature.

Regards,
Jamie

Jamie / Procurement —

Attached is the revised one-page commercial summary and term-sheet (v3) reflecting:
- Acceleration trigger: >130% for two consecutive months (as requested).
- 3% annual per-token escalation applied at each anniversary.
- Billing: 30% invoiced at signature (per PO), remaining wallet funded and available for monthly drawdown; quarterly true-ups and reporting.
- Overrun protection: during acceleration, interim overage rate capped at 75% list.

Operational checklist:

- RevOps (Laura): please confirm revenue deferral language and revenue recognition template for finance.
- Ops (Camila): confirm wallet enablement timeline (target 10 business days from PO clearance).

Next steps: send back signed PO + countersigned term-sheet; we'll convert to order and issue an invoice for the 30% upfront.

Thanks — looking forward to closing this out.
